instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file and use the existing circular sketch, defined by points at (-12, 0), (0, 8), and (12, 0), as the base profile. Create an 18 mm Part Design pad from the circle, then create two centered circular loft profiles on each side of the cylinder, with one profile having a 4 mm radius and the other having a 5 mm radius. Cut a tapered cavity through the solid using Part Design Subtractive Loft. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
